fee_notes: Uniform non-refundable $60,000 fee; 20% veterans/active-duty discount available. Multi-unit development: $60,000 for first park + $50,000 per additional park.
raw_excerpt: You will be required to pay us an initial franchise fee of $60,000 (the "Initial Franchise Fee") upon signing the Franchise Agreement. The Initial Franchise Fee is uniform and non-refundable.
